name: madar
description: Madar (مدار) — bilingual one-page site. The frontend (index.html/css/js) is plain HTML/CSS/JS with no build step. api/contact.js is a Vercel serverless function that saves Contact-section submissions to Postgres (Neon) via the `pg` package. bootstrap-icons is a dev-time icon source only — its SVGs are copied inline into index.html, so node_modules is never shipped to the browser.
